## EXPECTED FINDING

The most likely bug is one of these:

```
BUG A: No 1-minute data for Feb 27 → fallback returns STOP_HIT
  FIX: Use 30-minute candles for outcome when 1-min not available.
  30-min is less precise but WAY better than defaulting to LOSS.

BUG B: evaluateOutcome() has a bug where it always returns STOP_HIT
  when called from the backtest context (different code path).
  FIX: Trace the exact function call chain.

BUG C: The fill-phase logic (from Session 5) never finds a fill
  because it's looking for exact entry price in 1-min candles,
  and without 1-min data, it assumes no fill → marks as loss.
  FIX: For 30-min candles, check if candle range includes entry price.

BUG D: Signals generated by confirmIntradaySignals() have NULL T1/T2
  because of a code path that skips the calculation.
  FIX: Verify T1/T2 are set for every signal.
```
